packs.title: Rainbow Hunt
packs.tagline: Find nature in every color of the rainbow.
packs.summary: Collect six nature photos that build a rainbow from red to purple.

packs.title: Pick Your Color
packs.tagline: Each player chooses a color and builds a nature photo set.

packs.title: Tiny Worlds
packs.tagline: Look closely at textures, patterns, and miniature green worlds.
packs.summary: Find close-up details in bark, leaves, stones, seeds, and tiny green textures that most people walk past.
